themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing autonomous tasks in research, design, and product workflows, including automation and advanced decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and refactoring code, improving developer productivity.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI applications used to enhance or automate various aspects of user research and analysis.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Details how AI is applied to product development, roadmapping, and understanding user needs for better product outcomes.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Highlights AI's role in analyzing large datasets, extracting insights, and identifying patterns for research and business intelligence.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Discusses the methods, challenges, and criteria for assessing the effectiveness and suitability of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Addresses the ethical considerations, biases, and responsible implementation of AI in UX and user research contexts.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI chatbots and language models used for user interaction, feedback collection, and as research assistants.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall impact on the workforce, particularly in tech and research.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications directly supporting UX/UI design processes and user research methodologies.
